summary_en: 50,000 shares (2.5% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) up to ¥100M via open-market purchases on TSE Growth Market, 14 Aug–13 Nov 2026. Stated purpose: flexible capital allocation and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 13 August 2026, Reskill Corp.'s board of directors resolved to acquire up to 50,000 treasury shares (2.5% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a maximum aggregate price of ¥100 million. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market during the period 14 August to 13 November 2026. The company states the purpose is to implement flexible and dynamic capital allocation and enhance shareholder returns. The board notes that the buyback will reduce the company's floating share ratio, and therefore the CEO and principal shareholder, Matsuda Wataru, intends to sell a portion of his holdings in the market as needed during the fiscal year to maintain the listing maintenance standard for floating share ratio required by the TSE Growth Market.
